messages:
maria-partnerops: FYI Azure Marketplace ops flagged a blocker — POs submitted after their nightly cutoff (23:00 UTC) are rejected; their portal also requires a 'flattened' invoice payload. Acme Retail procurement is blocked.

liam-sales: Yikes. Which account and timeline? :grimacing:

maria-partnerops: Acme Retail. Their PO landed at 23:12 UTC and portal returns `PO_ACCEPTANCE_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`. I filed ticket AZ-7890 with Azure support asking for a manual accept while we remediate.

eva-finance: Our invoices currently include nested line items with per-line tax and breakdowns. Azure expects a single-level lines array. We could emit a flattened invoice, but need to validate GL mappings and downstream ETL. :thinking:

arjun-legal: Any contractual constraints? The last SOW/redline insisted on preserving line-item granularity for audit. If we change shape, get legal sign-off and ensure archive of originals.

liam-sales: Customer wants an immediate unblock. They could resubmit earlier but that requires internal change on their side and will delay close. They prefer we adapt for now.

noah-platform: Platform-side we can add a transform in the marketplace exporter that emits a flattened view and preserves the original payload in the archive. Safe if feature-flagged. Prototype ~1 day, 2-3 days for tested production rollout.

maria-partnerops: Good. Partnerships to coordinate with Azure for a temporary manual accept window while Platform ships the transform. I'll request a grace period in AZ-7890.

arjun-legal: Legal is OK with a temporary technical workaround provided Finance documents the reconciliation steps and we retain original nested payloads for audit. Please add a short legal note in the tracking doc.

eva-finance: I'll draft a GL impact note and quick reconciliation checklist. If Platform can version the payload (eg: marketplace_payload_version = 'flattened-v1') that's preferred for traceability.

noah-platform: We'll add a payload version metadata field and keep the original invoice. I'll post a prototype transform and sample payload in the Azure ticket today.

maria-partnerops: Action items:
- maria-partnerops: push AZ-7890 for manual accept window (in progress)
- noah-platform: post prototype transform + sample payload by EOD
- eva-finance: GL note + reconciliation checklist by EOD
- arjun-legal: sign-off comment in the workaround tracking doc
- liam-sales: notify Acme procurement with ETA and mitigation plan

liam-sales: I'll message Acme and set expectations. Thanks. :thumbsup:

noah-platform: Prototype snippet (pseudo):
```
// flatten line items into single-level lines array
const flattened = invoice.line_items.flatMap(li => [{description: li.name, amount: li.amount, tax_total: li.taxes.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)}]);
emit({lines: flattened, metadata: {marketplace_payload_version: 'flattened-v1'}});
```

maria-partnerops: Azure asked for a sample payload — noah, please add the sample JSON to AZ-7890 thread. Also requested a manual accept until we deploy flattened-v1.

noah-platform: Sample JSON and test file posted to AZ-7890.

eva-finance: Reconciliation doc published internally at https://redwood.internal/docs/finance/marketplace-invoice-flattening (internal link).

arjun-legal: Added legal note and left sign-off comment on the workaround doc.

maria-partnerops: Closing the loop here unless Azure refuses manual accept; marking thread as active escalation. Reopen if AZ pushes back. :eyes:
